trello.name: Renew and deploy SSL and internal CA certificates with auto-renewal
trello.desc: Ben to renew and deploy the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com by August 22nd (well before its September 1st expiry), and in the same change window rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh (expires ~September 15th). Move both certs onto cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward. Deploy renewed certs to the load balancers.

trello.name: PDF export for reports
trello.desc: Aisha to implement the PDF export feature for reports by end of month as one deliverable: backend renders the report to PDF with headless Chrome, frontend adds the export button and a progress state for large reports. As part of finishing the feature, record a short demo GIF for the marketing changelog.

trello.name: Restore staging environment parity with production
trello.desc: Ben to run the three pending staging migrations today, and write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge.
